records.title: 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED JANUARY 30, 2021
records.text: For fiscal 2020, total sales decreased 32.7% to $318.9 million from $474.0 million in fiscal 2019.

records.title: 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED JANUARY 30, 2021
records.text: Stores that have been open for 13 months are included in comparable sales.

records.title: 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED JANUARY 30, 2021
records.text: We decreased inventory levels by $17.4 million, or 17%, and our year-end inventory is current with clearance inventory down $1.4 million from February 1, 2020.

records.title: 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED JANUARY 30, 2021
records.text: Gross margin rate for fiscal 2020 was 32.9% compared to 43.1% in fiscal 2019.

records.title: 10-K FOR THE YEAR ENDED JANUARY 30, 2021
records.text: Our primary sources of liquidity are cash generated from operations and availability under our credit facility with Bank of America, N.A., which was most recently amended in April 2020 (“Credit Facility”).
